diff.name: JSON / Text diff
diff.jsonDescription: Ignore formatting and object key order; compare arrays by index.
diff.textDescription: Count changed line blocks; preserve spaces and case; normalize line endings to LF.
diff.inputHelp: Paste or drop files on either side

diff.legend: Additions, removals and modifications are marked separately. The summary counts all differences.

diff.dropHint: Read locally, then compare when both sides are ready
diff.dropSide: Drop the file in the original or new content area.

diff.pendingHint: Cancel at any time, or edit the input to compare again.

timestamp.name: Timestamp converter
timestamp.description: Convert seconds or milliseconds to and from dates in your chosen time zone.
timestamp.fallback: Device time zone unavailable. Using UTC; choose a zone manually.
timestamp.stampHelp: Converts as you type. Select a unit manually for other lengths.
timestamp.dateHelp: Dates without an offset use the selected time zone.
timestamp.dateFormat: ISO dates and Z / ±HH:mm offsets supported
timestamp.rounding: Integer seconds are rounded down; milliseconds are preserved.
timestamp.dst: Invalid dates and ambiguous or skipped local times are rejected.
timestamp.parsedOffset: Interpreted using the input UTC offset. The selected zone is used for display.
timestamp.invalidZone: Choose a valid IANA time zone, such as Asia/Shanghai or UTC.
timestamp.integer: Enter a decimal integer timestamp. Fractions and scientific notation are not supported.
timestamp.unknownUnit: Cannot detect the unit. Select seconds or milliseconds.
timestamp.range: Timestamp is outside the supported range. Check its value and unit.
timestamp.format: Use YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, with up to three fractional digits, or ISO format with Z / ±HH:mm.
timestamp.invalidOffset: Invalid date, time or UTC offset. Check all components.
timestamp.invalidDate: Invalid date or time. Check all components.
timestamp.ambiguous: This local time is skipped or repeated by a time zone transition. Change the time, or add an explicit UTC offset such as -04:00 or -05:00.

diagnostic.syntax1: JSON contains an unsupported character. Check punctuation, quotation marks and invisible characters.
diagnostic.syntax2: Invalid number. Use JSON number syntax, such as -12, 0.5 or 1e3.
diagnostic.syntax3: Property names must use double quotes. Use a quoted key followed by a colon and a value.
diagnostic.syntax4: Missing JSON value. Enter an object, array, string, number, true, false or null; remove any trailing comma.
diagnostic.syntax5: Missing colon after a property name. Add : between the key and its value.
diagnostic.syntax6: Missing comma between properties or array items. Add , between adjacent items.
diagnostic.syntax7: Missing closing brace. Add the object's closing }.
diagnostic.syntax8: Missing closing bracket. Add the array's closing ].
diagnostic.syntax9: Extra content after the root value. Keep one root value or place multiple values in an array.
diagnostic.syntax10: Standard JSON does not support comments. Remove // or /* */ comments.
diagnostic.syntax11: Unclosed comment. Standard JSON does not support comments; remove the comment.
diagnostic.syntax12: Unclosed string. Add the closing double quote and escape any double quotes inside the string.
diagnostic.syntax13: Incomplete number. Decimal points and exponents must be followed by digits.
diagnostic.syntax14: Invalid Unicode escape. Use \u followed by four hexadecimal digits.
diagnostic.syntax15: Invalid string escape. After \, use only a double quote, \, /, b, f, n, r, t or u.
diagnostic.syntax16: Unescaped control character. Use \n, \r and \t for newline, carriage return and tab.
diagnostic.DuplicateKey: Duplicate property name. Keys must be unique within the same object.
diagnostic.EmptyInput: The input is empty. Paste or import JSON to compare.
diagnostic.TaskFailed: The task could not finish. Try again; if it persists, reload the tool.
diagnostic.NestingLimit: JSON nesting is too deep. Reduce nesting or split the data.
diagnostic.SizeLimit: Data exceeds the browser's processing capacity. Split the file or free browser resources.
diagnostic.InvalidEncoding: The file is not valid UTF-8. Save it as UTF-8 and import it again.

md5.name: MD5 digest
md5.title: MD5 digest & verification
md5.description: Text, lines, files and HMAC. All processing stays in your browser.
md5.security: MD5 is an irreversible digest for checksums and legacy compatibility. Do not use it for passwords or collision-resistant signatures. HMAC-MD5 is a compatibility feature.
md5.truncatedNote: 16-character compatibility values use the middle 16 Hex characters, not the full MD5 digest.

compare.empty: Enter an expected digest to verify.

md5.limits: Text 10 MiB · 10,000 lines · 100 files · 4 GiB per file · key 64 KiB
md5.manual: Ready. Files, batches, HMAC and text over 256 KiB run manually.
md5.batchPreview: Batch results · select a line to copy its digest
md5.linesHint: Line endings are excluded. Spaces, duplicate lines and intermediate empty lines are preserved. A final line ending does not add a record.
md5.fileHint: Raw bytes, 2 MiB chunks. Files with duplicate names stay separate.
md5.clearKeyHint: The key is cleared after completion, failure, cancellation or leaving this tool.

errors.encoding: Input cannot be encoded losslessly using the selected representation.
errors.representation: Invalid byte representation. Check Hex or Base64 input.
errors.start: Could not start the calculation. Try again.

office.error: Unable to complete this task. Check the input and try again.
office.timeout: The task timed out. Reduce the input and try again.

office.unsupported: This file type is not supported.

office.steps: 1. Add your content → 2. Choose an action → 3. Copy or download the result
office.exampleNotice: This is a local example. Edit the input to try your own content.
office.regexPurpose: Developer tool: find and extract text using a pattern, or replace matching text. Try the order-number example first.

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.description: Precise arithmetic, percentages and everyday business calculations. All processing stays on your device.
calculator.expressionHint: Example: 200 + 10% or sqrt(81) + 2^3. Supported functions: abs, round, floor, ceil, sum, mean, min, max. Use commas between function arguments.
calculator.approximate: ≈ Display rounded to 24 significant digits. Copy uses the full result (up to 80 significant digits).
calculator.precision: Uses 80 significant digits. Repeating fractions and irrational numbers are finite precision approximations.
calculator.businessHint: Growth: original, new. Discount: price, percentage off. Share: part, whole. Find a part: whole, percentage. Find the whole: part, percentage.
calculator.notAllowed: This expression contains unsupported syntax or functions.
calculator.tooComplex: The expression is too complex. Shorten it and retry.
calculator.nonFinite: The result is undefined or outside the supported numeric range.
calculator.name: Calculator

dates.title: Date calculator
dates.description: Compare ISO dates, add calendar periods, count workdays and find anniversaries. Pure dates are independent of time zones.
dates.constrain: Month and year calculations constrain invalid dates to the final day of the month. Example: January 31 + one month → February 28 or 29.
dates.listHint: Enter ISO dates separated by spaces, commas or newlines. Monday–Friday are workdays by default. An explicit working date overrides a day off, including weekends. No national holiday calendar is applied.
dates.intervalHint: Counts start date through the day before end date by default. Reverse ranges return a negative count. The inclusive option also counts the end date.
dates.invalidDate: Use a valid ISO date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
dates.invalidAmount: Enter a whole number within ±1,000,000 and select a supported unit.
dates.outOfRange: The calculated date is outside the supported range.
dates.rangeTooLarge: Choose a workday range shorter than 1,000 years.
dates.futureOrigin: The birth or anniversary date must not follow the reference date.
dates.countdownHint: For a countdown, use today as the start and choose the target as the end. Past targets return a negative day count. Anniversary ages use the final day of February for February 29 in non-leap years.
dates.name: Date calculator

qr.name: Generate and read QR codes
qr.description: Turn a link or text into a QR image, or read the original content from a QR-code screenshot. Choose Generate or Read, then add your content.
qr.generate: Turn text or a link into a QR code
qr.marginHelp: Four-module quiet zone. Default correction level M; higher correction holds less text. Output grows if needed to preserve at least one pixel per module.
qr.recognize: Read a QR code from an image
qr.imageHelp: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (up to 20 MiB and 16 megapixels).
qr.drop: Drop an image here, or paste an image using your keyboard.
qr.localHelp: One QR result per image. Decoded text stays here; links are never opened automatically. No camera, uploads or permissions.
qr.tooLong: The content is too long for this correction level. Shorten it or choose a lower level.
qr.invalidSize: Enter an integer image size from 128 to 2048 pixels.
qr.invalidLevel: Choose L, M, Q or H correction.
qr.notFound: No QR code was found. Try a clearer, uncropped image.
qr.decodeError: The image could not be decoded.
qr.imageType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

images.import: Add JPG, PNG or WebP images
images.drop: Drop images here or choose files
images.limits: Static images only. Up to 30 files / 100 MiB total; 16,384 px per side and 40 megapixels per image. All processing stays on this device.

images.allowReduce: Allow lower resolution to reach target size

images.targetMiss: Target size could not be reached with these settings.
images.unsupported: Use valid static JPG, PNG or WebP files.
images.animated: Animated PNG and WebP files are unsupported.
images.dimensions: Image dimensions must be 1–16,384 px per side and at most 40 megapixels; scale must be 1–400%.
images.limit: Limit exceeded: 30 images, 100 MiB total input/output, 50 MiB per input.
images.failed: Image processing failed. Check the input or use a smaller image.
images.formatError: This browser cannot encode the chosen output format.
images.invalidSettings: Quality must be 1–100, target size 0–102,400 KiB, and dimensions / scale must be valid numbers.
images.name: Compress and edit images
images.description: Make an image smaller for uploading, crop unwanted areas, change its dimensions, or convert PNG, JPG and WebP. Add images, process, then download.

text.name: Clean and extract text
text.description: Paste a list to remove duplicate lines, extract phone numbers or emails, replace text in bulk, or hide sensitive fields. Copy or download the cleaned result.
text.inputHelp: Type, paste or drop a UTF-8 TXT file. Input limit: 10 MiB.
text.replace: Find and replace text in bulk
text.extract: Extract phone numbers, emails or links
text.literalHelp: All occurrences are replaced literally. Dollar signs and regular expression symbols have no special meaning.
text.extractHelp: Common format extraction only; does not verify ownership, deliverability or identity. At most 10,000 matches.
text.maskHelp: Preview replaces selected common patterns. Phone: first 3 and last 4 digits; email: first character and domain; ID: first 6 and last 4 characters. Check the result before sharing; other sensitive content is not detected.
text.matchTruncated: Extraction stopped at 10,000 matches. Reduce input to extract the rest.
text.previewTruncated: Preview limited to 1 MiB. Copy and download include the complete result.
text.emptyFind: Enter the literal text to find.
text.invalidText: Use valid Unicode text or a UTF-8 text file.
text.conversionError: The text operation failed. Check the input and try again.

units.title: Unit converter
units.description: Convert common physical units with high precision. Search English or Chinese unit names and compare multiple targets.
units.allTargets: Show every target in this category
units.precision: Results display up to 24 significant digits. ≈ marks display rounding; copying preserves up to 80 significant digits. Unit factors use mathjs definitions; gallons and fluid ounces are US units.
units.other: Byte size and time interval conversions
units.otherLink: Open the existing encoding and conversion toolkit
units.noMatches: No matching units in this category.
units.invalidValue: Enter a valid finite decimal number within the supported range.
units.invalidUnit: Select valid source and target units.
units.incompatible: Source and target units must belong to the same category.

money.hint: Enter digits with optional thousands commas and decimal places. Negative and large values are supported. Values are rounded half up to two decimal places; scientific notation is not accepted.
money.roundedNotice: Original {{original}} was rounded half up to {{rounded}}.
money.invalidAmount: Enter a valid decimal amount, with correctly grouped optional thousands commas (up to 1,000 characters).

pdf.drop: Drop files here or choose files
pdf.limits: Up to 100 files, 100 MiB total input/output and 1,000 pages. Images: 40 megapixels per file, 120 megapixels total. Processing stays on this device. Single-document operations require exactly one PDF.
pdf.split: Split each page into a ZIP
pdf.rangeHelp: Use 1-3,5. Reorder requires every page exactly once, in the desired order, e.g. 3,1,2. Page numbers start at 1; duplicate, reversed and out-of-range values are rejected.
pdf.preservation: A new PDF is created. Form interactivity, bookmarks, attachments, document metadata and digital signatures may not be preserved. Encrypted PDFs are unsupported. This tool lists page order; it does not render PDF pages.
pdf.rangeError: Invalid page selection. Use ranges such as 1-3,5, without duplicates, reversed ranges or numbers outside the document.
pdf.completeOrder: Reordering requires every page exactly once.
pdf.singleFile: Choose exactly one PDF for this operation.
pdf.empty: Deleting every page would create an empty PDF.
pdf.encrypted: Encrypted PDFs are unsupported. Provide an unencrypted copy.
pdf.invalid: The PDF cannot be read or is damaged.
pdf.limit: Limit exceeded: 100 files, 100 MiB total input/output, 1,000 pages, or image dimensions (16,384 px per side, 40 megapixels per image / 120 megapixels total).
pdf.imageDecode: This browser cannot decode the image. Use a static JPG or PNG.
pdf.failed: PDF processing failed. Check the selected files or use smaller inputs.
pdf.fileType: Choose PDF files for PDF operations, or static JPG, PNG and WebP for Images to PDF.
pdf.name: Merge and split PDFs
pdf.description: Combine PDF files, keep only selected pages, split a PDF into separate pages, or turn photos into a PDF. Choose a task and add your files.

draw.name: Random draws and groups
draw.description: Choose entries, shuffle lists or draw inclusive integers with browser cryptographic randomness.
draw.listHelp: One entry per line. Blank lines are ignored; duplicate names remain separate entries until you remove duplicates.
draw.numberHelp: Use safe integer endpoints spanning at most 4,294,967,296 values. Draw up to 100,000 numbers; without repetition, the requested count must fit the range.
draw.invalidCount: Enter a positive integer count within the available entries or range (maximum 100,000).
draw.invalidRange: Enter safe integer endpoints with minimum ≤ maximum and a span of at most 4,294,967,296 values.
draw.empty: Enter at least one nonblank list entry.

timer.name: Countdown and stopwatch
timer.description: Local timers with lap tracking and same-tab session restoration.
timer.sound: Play a short sound on completion when this page can play audio
timer.backgroundHelp: Timing uses clock deadlines and elapsed time. State is kept in this tab’s session storage. Background tabs and sleeping devices can suspend execution; this is not a background reminder or alarm.
timer.invalidDuration: Enter a whole number of seconds from 1 to 31,536,000.
timer.soundUnavailable: Sound is unavailable. The countdown will still finish visually.
